title: Large deviation principle for friendship-biases in Galton--Watson trees
summary: In this paper we consider the friendship-bias of the vertices in an infinite rooted Galton--Watson tree. The friendship-bias of a vertex is the difference between the average degree of the neighbours of the vertex and the degree of the vertex itself. A vertex is said to be of type $χ\in S$, with $S = \{-,0,+\}$, when its friendship-bias is, respectively, strictly negative, zero or strictly positive.
